title: iDISCO Clearing and Staining of Pancreas
author: Maria Jimenez Gonzalez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baxbifin
materials: Preparation of Buffers - Heparinized PBS: 10 mg/100 ml PBS - Prepare a 4% PFA solution in PBS (Dilution of 1:4 of 16%PFA)

Place the solutions (Heparanized PBS and 4% PFA) in a box with ice and prime the tubes of the perfusion pump with HeparInized PBS. Anesthetize the mouse by inducing anesthesia with Isoflurane at 3%. One deeply anesthetized, place the mouse in supine position and keep anesthesia at 1-1.5% using an orofacial mask. Open the abdominal cavity, open the diaphragm and place the needle (22-25G) attached to the perfusion pump tube into the left ventricle of the heart. Subsequently, pierce the right atrium with a needle. Start the perfusion at a rate of 5 ml/min. Check that the blood is coming out and that the liver is getting pale. After infusing 20 mL aproximately, change to the infusion of 4% PFA. After 1-2 min, there must be a ‘shrinking’ of the body.After infusing 20 mL of PFA, the perfusion is finished, proceed to harvest the tissues of interests in the microtubes.

Preparation of buffers: Ptx2 1L: - Triton X-100 2 ml - Sodium Azide 0.01% - PBS 100 mM, pH 7.4 PtwH 1L: - Tween-20 2 ml - Heparin 10 mg - Sodium Azide 0.01% - PBS 100 mM, pH 7.4 Permeabilization Buffer 0.5L: - Triton X-100 0.8 ml - Glycine 11.5 g - DMSO 100 ml

steps.title: Dissect pancreas and fix
steps.instruction: Using a dissection microscope, remove the pancreas from the abdomen, excise fat, lymph nodes and hair while immersed in PBS, then place the organ in 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Initial PBS washes
steps.instruction: The next day, wash the fixed pancreas three times with PBS at room temperature.

steps.title: Cut tissue for clearing
steps.instruction: If proceeding to clearing, cut the pancreas into approximately eight equal pieces to facilitate antibody permeabilization.

steps.title: Dehydrate tissue (first series)
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the pieces in a methanol‑water gradient at room temperature while shaking at 20–30 rpm in a wave‑motion shaker:

substeps.instruction: 100 % methanol for 1 h or overnight at 4 °C
66 % dichloromethane (DCM) / 33 % methanol for 3 h (protect from light)
100 % methanol for 1 h or overnight at 4 °C

steps.title: Bleach tissue
steps.instruction: Bleach the dehydrated samples as follows:

substeps.instruction: Wash twice in 100 % methanol at room temperature
Incubate in freshly prepared 5 % H₂O₂ / 95 % methanol solution overnight at 4 °C

steps.title: Rehydrate tissue (gradient)
steps.instruction: Rehydrate the bleached samples in a reverse methanol‑water gradient at room temperature while shaking at 20–30 rpm:

substeps.instruction: Replace Ptx2 and incubate for another 1 h
Place samples in Permeabilization Buffer and shake at 37 °C for 1 day

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate samples in blocking buffer (6 % donkey serum, 10 % DMSO in Ptx2) while shaking at 37 °C for 48 h.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibodies in 3 % donkey serum, 10 % DMSO prepared in PtwH and incubate the samples while shaking at 37 °C for 96 h.

substeps.instruction: GP and rat anti‑insulin antibodies at 1:1000

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash samples in PtwH 4–5 times, each wash for at least 1 h with shaking at room temperature, then leave the samples in the final wash overnight.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Dilute secondary antibodies in 3 % donkey serum in PtwH and incubate while shaking at 37 °C for 96 h; use a 1:500 dilution for all secondaries.

steps.title: Wash after secondary
steps.instruction: Wash samples in PtwH 4–5 times, each wash for at least 1 h with shaking at room temperature, and leave the samples in the last wash overnight.

steps.title: Final dehydration series
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the stained tissue in a methanol‑water gradient at room temperature while shaking at 20–30 rpm:

steps.title: Clear tissue in organic solvents
steps.instruction: Clear the dehydrated samples as follows (protect from light):

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 66 % DCM / 33 % methanol for 3 h at room temperature with shaking
Transfer to 100 % DCM for 15 min at room temperature with shaking
Replace with fresh 100 % DCM for another 15 min
Place samples in dibenzyl ether (DBE) and shake at room temperature (transparent after 30–60 min)
Clean any DBE spills with methanol
Store cleared samples in DBE at 4 °C; they remain stable for months

steps.title: Mount for confocal imaging
steps.instruction: Mount cleared pancreas pieces for confocal microscopy:

substeps.instruction: For upright microscopes, place samples in 3D‑printed VisiJet holders (see protocol link)
For inverted microscopes, place samples on glass‑bottom slides (e.g., ibidi cat# 80827)
Acquire images (e.g., .czi) and visualize/quantify with IMARIS software
